comment: Corrected C-first A83 fire-trap-on-ICE recipe. The preserved first C attempt showed PICK_ANY keeps #wizintrinsic open after selecting fire resistance; its space scrolled to page 3 and subsequent wish text was consumed by the menu. This frozen correction sends newline to finish the property menu and one space for the observed resistance-message More, then wishes a fire trap on the source-observed ICE square and leaves/returns to trigger it. The setup is still not JS-compared. C run-ojLeMX confirms the trap is created, but its first h key attacks an adjacent newt and leaves the hero on the trap; the following l moves east. This frozen follow-up reverses that observed movement order so the hero steps east off the trap and then west back onto it. It remains C-first and is not JS-compared. C run-jRu74y shows the intervening newt stepped on and consumed the fire trap while the hero moved east; the final screen leaves the hero adjacent east of the visible trap glyph. This frozen third recipe adds one westward step to enter that observed trap square as the hero. No JS comparison yet. C run-pMkv0S reaches the trap tile at step81 and asks “Really fly onto that fire trap? [yn] (n)”. This frozen follow-up answers yes at that observed prompt so C can show the hero-triggered effect and any recursive ICE callback.
